summary.name: GNU Mailman
summary.one_liner: GNU Mailman is free, GPL-licensed software written in Python for managing electronic mail discussion and e-newsletter lists.
use_cases: manage subscriber accounts on a mailing list
summary.what_it_does:
Mailman manages email discussion lists and e-newsletter lists. It is integrated with the web so users can manage their own accounts and list owners can administer lists through a web interface. Built-in features named on the page include archiving, automatic bounce processing, content filtering, digest delivery and spam filters. The page lists Mailman 3.3.10 (released 01-Oct-2024) and Mailman 2.1.39 (released 13-Dec-2021) as current stable versions.</what_it_does>
